name: LightGaussian / CompGS / RDOGS
aliases: Compressing Gaussian Splat Radiance Field Models with Vector Quantization
definition: Compression: prune redundant Gaussians, quantize parameters, learned codebooks.
summary: LightGaussian, or CompGS, compresses 3D Gaussian Splatting by pruning redundant Gaussians during training with a sliding window mask and quantizing parameters via learned codebooks, achieving tenfold storage reduction.
